sentToWms.description: Warehouse-submission status reported by IDS; omitted if absent.

FunctionOutput_ids_fulfillment_updateite.description: The matching IDS item processing result, without implying warehouse completion.

tags.instructions: Use for an existing SKU from `get-item` or `list-items`. Use `create-item` for a new SKU and `delete-item` to delete one. Omitted changes are preserved; explicit null clears a supported optional field. Concurrent updates can race because the API exposes no revision guard.

functions.name: update-item-lot-status
functions.description: Change the WMS status of one item lot without changing its quantity.

itemCode.description: Warehouse SKU whose lot is changed.

lotCode.description: Primary lot code for that SKU.

status.description: Target inventory status; replaces only the lot status and does not accept a quantity.

FunctionInput_ids_fulfillment_updateitem.description: Identify one item lot and the target status without changing quantity.

itemCode.description: SKU reported in the adjustment response.

lotCode.description: Lot reported in the adjustment response.

status.description: Target status in the same named vocabulary as the input.

successful.description: Warehouse-reported success from SentToWmsStatus; null or absent means not established.

message.description: Warehouse result message, including a failure explanation.

FunctionOutput_ids_fulfillment_updateite.description: Lot status and the warehouse-reported adjustment outcome, without inferring success from HTTP acceptance.

tags.instructions: Use for a lot status change, not a quantity adjustment. Obtain the SKU and lot from `list-storer-inventory`. This can affect allocation and availability. Inspect successful and message; an accepted HTTP response may still report that the warehouse adjustment failed.
